This paper proposes a forecasting model for inflation using macroeconomic time series.
The dataset contains monthly observations from 1990 to 2025.
The method is compared with an ARIMA baseline and evaluated with RMSE and CRPS metrics.
The main limitation is that robustness to data revisions is not fully tested.

The second page describes implementation details.
Replication code is available in a public repository.
The model architecture combines probabilistic forecasts with interpretable features.
